summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Qualivian Focus Fund ETF (QFF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively manages a narrow portfolio of large- and mid-cap US companies believed to offer the potential for long-term compounding of capital. The fund uses a four-stage process that seeks minimal trading activity, broad diversification, and short-term market reactions. QFF was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Qualivian.

holdings.infoBox: QFF is an equity ETF with a total of 24 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 10.45%, Alphabet at 7.21%, Microsoft at 6.09%, Visa Inc. at 5.92%, and Mastercard at 5.39%.
